E2-2018-T1-P1-S4.trunk: 疑问主干：When did it become accepted wisdom that…?（何时……成了公认的道理？）
structure: 特殊疑问句：When did it become accepted wisdom
└ 同位/内容从句(that)：that students should be able to name the 13th president of the United States but be utterly overwhelmed by a broken bike chain
├ 并列谓语①：should be able to name…
└ 并列谓语②(but)：〔should〕be utterly overwhelmed by…
E2-2018-T1-P1-S4.logic: it作形式主语或泛指情形，that从句给出所谓“公认道理”的具体内容；but并列强烈反差，构成反问。
notes: accepted wisdom指“普遍接受的看法、公认道理”。
be overwhelmed by在此表示“面对……完全不知所措”。

E2-2018-T1-P1-S16.trunk: 主句：the push…and the devaluing…miss an important point（对学位的盲目追逐和对其他选择的贬低忽略了一个要点）
structure: 并列主语①：the headlong push into bachelor's degrees for all
并列主语②：and the subtle devaluing of anything less
谓语宾语：misses an important point
冒号后解释point：That's not the only thing
└ 定语从句〔省略that，修饰 thing〕：the American economy needs
E2-2018-T1-P1-S16.logic: 两个并列名词短语共同指出教育取向的偏差；冒号后的句子解释被忽略的要点，即经济需求并非只有学士学位。
notes: headlong表示“轻率而迅猛的、不顾一切的”。
anything less指低于学士学位的教育或资格。
the only thing the economy needs中省略了关系代词that。

E2-2018-T1-P1-S20.trunk: 主句：one obvious solution is staring us in the face（一个显而易见的解决方案就摆在眼前）
structure: 时间状语从句：at a time when the working class has turned the country on its political head
├ 定语从句(when，修饰 a time)：when the working class has turned the country on its political head
└ 过去分词短语补充working class：frustrated that the opportunity…is vanishing
└ 定语从句(that，修饰 opportunity)：that once defined America
主句：one obvious solution is staring us in the face
E2-2018-T1-P1-S20.logic: at a time when交代政治背景，frustrated进一步解释工人阶层改变政治格局的原因，最后主句强调解决方案其实显而易见。
notes: turn something on its head意为“彻底颠覆、完全改变”。
frustrated that…是过去分词短语，补充说明working class的状态。
stare sb in the face是习语，指“明摆在某人眼前”。
